Connect with CNA Why CNA Touchstone Property Stands Apart Streamlined from start to finish Engineered to facilitate fast quoting, binding and renewal. Confidence you can trust Backed by CNA's financial strength and more than a century of claims and broker expertise. Flexible to fit your needs Core coverage made simple, with specialized endorsements available to fine‑tune protection as needs evolve. Coverage Highlights Our commercial property coverage protects your buildings and business property, as well as lost income and ongoing expenses when operations are disrupted by a covered event. Blanket Limit Options A range of flexible blanket limit options is available for Property Damage and Business Income Business Income Available on Gross Earnings or Gross Profits basis Deductible Options Available Deductible options are designed to provide flexibility across a range of risk profiles Recognizing Our Insured's Emerging Needs Special coverages are available within the policy form including: Attraction Property Crisis Management Emergency Evacuation Expenses Equipment Breakdown included directly in the form (no addendum required) Historic Building Preservation Impounded Water Logistics Extra Cost Money and Securities Tenants Legal Liability Upgrade to Green Vehicles or Self-Propelled Machines Image Single Carrier or Quota Share Flexibility Whether insuring 100% ground up or participating on a quota-share structure as the lead market , CNA provides options that align with complex property program needs while maintaining consistency, transparency, and expertise. Capabilities CAT Expertise CNA brings deep catastrophe expertise grounded in advanced modeling and analytics focused on high hazard exposures. This technical foundation is strengthened by specialized engineering insights that help assess and address vulnerabilities across complex property environments. When large scale events occur, CNA provides a dependable and experienced response approach designed to support continuity, clarity, and informed decision making throughout the event lifecycle. Together, these capabilities help organizations build resilience and navigate catastrophe exposed risks with confidence. Risk Control CNA’s Risk Control team helps organizations stay ahead of evolving exposures with tailored guidance, industry specific expertise and cutting edge tools. Leveraging decades of experience and advanced resources like PrepWise®, eRiskHub® and SORCE®, our specialists identify risks early and deliver actionable strategies to strengthen safety, boost resilience and reduce loss potential. From virtual assessments to hands on training, CNA provides practical, proactive solutions designed to help businesses operate with confidence. Explore CNA’s full Risk Control capabilities: https://www.cna.com/risk-control . Claims CNA’s Claims team delivers fast, expert support backed by deep industry knowledge and advanced analytics. From 24/7 reporting to proactive guidance throughout the claim lifecycle, our specialists focus on clarity, responsiveness and getting insureds back to business quickly. With powerful digital tools, real time insights and consistently high customer satisfaction, CNA provides a claims experience built on expertise, efficiency and confidence. For more information on our Claims team and their expertise, please visit: https://www.cna.com/claims/claims-services .
